messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] merge affymetrix microarray data sets from same platform
parts:
Hi.

On Wed, May 29, 2013 at 3:12 AM, shangzhong Li <shangzh...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am trying to analyse GSE 30321 datasets in R. However it has 295 samples
> in two files (one has 255 and another has 40). They have same platform.
> gset <- getGEO('GSE30321',GSEMatrix =TRUE)
> gives gset two elements. Does anyone know how to combine the two files into
> one and give gset only one element with 295 samples? thank you.

I guess you are referring to getGEO() of the GEOquery Bioconductor
package, which is completely unrelated to the aroma.affymetrix
package. Please report your question on the Bioconductor mailing
list.

/Henrik
